display_name: LoRa W24 同包双扰动难例风险（Full）
description: Match mean and smooth worst-view classification losses over two independent perturbations of the same physical source packet.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Both arms reuse frozen E104 and clean U_s pseudo labels at confidence >= .95. Same source L_s true labels on two independent disturbed views. Infer from one received IQ with fixed E104. Fit reads no hidden U_s TX, source V, registered practical, exact simulation traces or target.

checkpoint.initialization: Exact shared strong-source G at 40000 cumulative updates, original E104 frozen throughout. Two independent AdamW resets, update all existing recovery weights. No parameter or inference graph change.

sources.role: New G common source freeze and archival Full comparator.
Frozen first recovery and formal Full historical comparator.
Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The E104 and strong-source parents were selected on source prior to target. Target outcomes do not affect configuration, eligibility or replay.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at +12000. On the same 300 Full source V packets, only hard_view_risk may promote. Six must exceed every registered comparison, low urban exceeds mean_view_risk and is at least as high as all archived comparisons, clean reaches both direct and strong parent.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 7,0,2,6,3,5. At least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight existing contexts. Up to two training or three formal prediction workers, one new worker per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on invalid role, incompatible source checkpoint, inactive L_s or accepted clean U_s gradient in the real smoke, update of E104, nonfinite objective, or incomplete prediction. A missed source gate ends the experiment at source.

metric_names: sampled waveform and clean training losses
strong source branch actual sampled exposures and nominal SNR range
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.seed_notes: 2026113007 fixed physical draw and original generic perturbation RNG; 2026113008 independent strong replacement stream. Shared both arms.
rows.optimizer: AdamW G LR 4e-5, cosine to 2e-6, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 updates per arm after 40000-step parent. Per update 8 L_s and 8 U_s physical packet exposures, each paired with two independent disturbance draws. Total 96000 exposures per role and 384000 disturbed views per arm.

rows.seed_notes: 2026113007 fixed physical draw and original generic perturbation RNG; 2026113008 independent strong replacement stream. Shared both arms.
rows.optimizer: AdamW G LR 4e-5, cosine to 2e-6, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 updates per arm after 40000-step parent. Per update 8 L_s and 8 U_s physical packet exposures, each paired with two independent disturbance draws. Total 96000 exposures per role and 384000 disturbed views per arm.

notes: Only pairing reduction changes. Each physical training packet has two independent generic mixture draws. For per-packet losses v1 and v2, m=mean(v), candidate risk m + .75*.25*(logsumexp((v-m)/.25)-log(2)); control risk m. Applied to L_s true CE and accepted clean U_s pseudo CE only. An accepted packet uses the same clean pseudo label for both views. All other losses average matching data; EQ 0.95 and original objective weights remain unchanged.

Both rows use the same original W24 native path, legal source 2800 labeled and 25200 hidden-label IQ, the same full strong 308676-param base and same augmentation including one-third -8 to +4 dB nominal strong white drops. Both infer single received aperture and preserve native edges.

Freeze both before 300-packet Full source scoring. If the candidate passes the preregistered source gate, auto-predict all seven formal Full views and only after all freeze execute independent truth-last.
